name: hardware-low-vertex
text:
VERT
DCL IN[0]
DCL OUT[0], POSITION
DCL OUT[1], GENERIC[0]
DCL CONST[0..45]
DCL TEMP[0..117]
MOV TEMP[17], CONST[5]
MUL TEMP[9], IN[0], CONST[7]
ADD TEMP[8], TEMP[9], CONST[0]
MOV OUT[0], TEMP[8]
MOV OUT[1], TEMP[8]
MOV OUT[1].w, TEMP[17].xxxx
END

name: hardware-inactive-vertex
text:
VERT
DCL IN[0]
DCL OUT[0], POSITION
DCL CONST[0..45]
MOV OUT[0], IN[0]
END

name: hardware-inactive-fragment
text:
FRAG
DCL OUT[0], COLOR
DCL CONST[0..45]
IMM[0] FLT32 {1, 0, 0, 1}
MOV OUT[0], IMM[0]
END
